text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡
It's Loves Only You♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Today is finally the day we depart for Dubai!
Reporting live from the airport~♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Is it finally time~?" "Hope you arrive safely!"
"Be careful of infectious diseases!" "I'm getting nervous!"
"No streams for a while?" "So excited!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
...Yeah, I might not be able to stream for a while.
Doesn't look like I can set up my gear over there.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Instead, I'll make sure to show everyone what it's like over there
through my blog and UmaStagram!
Give me loooots of support, okay? ♡"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Can't wait!" "Our hearts are always with you!"
"Believe in victory!" "You can do it, Bridge!"
"Hip hip hooray!" "Spread your wings toward the dream—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so Loves Only You received
heartfelt words of encouragement
from her circle of friends—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To the stage of our dreams.
Together, we took flight towards the land of Dubai—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Here is our top story.
Regarding the global spread of an infectious disease—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—With no end in sight, large-scale events
both domestic and abroad are seeing widespread cancellations—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—In the face of this unprecedented crisis,
people's daily lives have been forced to change—"

text_block_list.name: Expedition Support Staff
text_block_list.text:
"...We just received an official notice from management.
This year's Dubai International G1 will be—"

text_block_list.name: Expedition Support Staff
text_block_list.text: ――Cancel the event, you say?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: No way—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Then, does that mean we will be returning home immediately?

text_block_list.name: Expedition Support Staff
text_block_list.text: "Well, they told us that the departure procedures would take several days—"

text_block_list.name: Expedition Support Staff
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry to all of you, but...
you will have to stay at this hotel for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, all too simply,
Loves Only You was forced to give up on
her challenge on the world stage—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...A few days have passed since
receiving news of the cancellation."

text_block_list.name: Online Article
text_block_list.text: "—As an infectious disease countermeasure, the Twinkle Series has officially decided to hold races without spectators—"

text_block_list.name: Online Article
text_block_list.text:
"—It has been announced that Winning Lives will also be suspended for the time being.
Disappointed voices can be heard from race fans—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The spread of the infection and its fallout
drastically transformed the world in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Day after day, the news was filled with gloomy stories worrying about the changes brought by the pandemic, as if we had stepped into an endless mist...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer-kun.
choice_data_list: Loves...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer-chan.
choice_data_list: Loves...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for reaching out out of the blue.
...Do you have just a moment to talk?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for the tea.
Sorry for making you worry about me."
choice_data_list: No, don't worry about it. Take your time and make yourself at home.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I still can't believe it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—...Over how easily
it got cancelled.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
To the point where I almost deluded myself into thinking
that the race was definitely going to be held today when I woke up...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...It just doesn't feel real to me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...This won't do. I need to look forward
and prepare for my return home, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I...
still haven't been able to... shake it off...
choice_data_list: ...There's nothing wrong with that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You poured so much of herself into this Dubai campaign that it could be called the culmination of everything.
...She was carrying her community members' dreams alongside her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For it to end in such an unfortunate manner...
Who could possibly fault them for grieving—
choice_data_list: If it hurts... you don't have to hold it in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she needs right now surely isn't endurance.
It is to put her despair into words and let it out.
And the one to receive those feelings is—
choice_data_list: ...I'll take on everything you've got.
...Because I'll take on everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer, kun... ngh——

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer... chan...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Ahh...
Aaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Why... Why, of all things...!
Getting injured... and missing Hong Kong...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, we were all... looking ahead...
and receiving... so much love... and yet――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The pain resonated.
Turning into a lament only I could hear."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, the next day.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—R-Really...?
I can stream...!? For real...!?
choice_data_list: Yeah! I got the equipment and permission...!
Yeah! I got the equipment and permission...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The best way to cheer up Loves Only You is definitely to connect with the community members she loves so dearly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I asked various people for cooperation
ever since the hotel stay was decided,
and now, after several days, it has finally come true...!
choice_data_list: I'm sure everyone wants to see Loves too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! I want to see everyone too...!!
I want to see them and talk with them...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright...!
Time to get ready for the stream—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
choice_data_list: ...Loves...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone must be disappointed too.
Seeing my challenge end like this.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So... that's precisely why... I have to face forward
and talk to everyone properly...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I can't put on a gloomy face...!
I have to encourage everyone...!
choice_data_list: Loves, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm fine, Trainer-kun.
I'm not overdoing it.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm fine, Trainer-chan.
I'm not overdoing it.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Because you were there to support me through the hardest part, Trainer-kun... I'm alright now.
choice_data_list: ...Understood. Let's get ready for the stream.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Because you were there to support me through the hardest part, Trainer-chan... I'm alright now.
choice_data_list: ...Understood. Let's get ready for the stream.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡
Loves Only You here—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......No way.
So many people have gathered already—

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"I missed you!" "I was so worried~!"
"Are you okay over there?" "How've you been!?"
"I'm so glad you're safe." "What a relief~."

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"That must have been so frustrating...! It must have hurt so much...!
Thank you so much for streaming for us anyway...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone...—

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad you're safe...! Praying you can
come home as soon as possible! Don't worry,
you'll definitely get another chance at this!"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, it's not over yet!"
"Don't give up!" "We'll always cheer for you!"
"You'll get another chance!" "You got this↑↑"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I meant to encourage them...
but I ended up being the one cheered up instead...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone. Thank you so much.
I feel so, sooooo energized now♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right. Even if the race was cancelled, even with the infection going around, I still have people cheering me on like this...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have my commu-members...
I can try again, as many times as it takes...!
choice_data_list: ...Let's start over from here.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Right here and now, I swear it in front of everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll challenge the world again someday...!
I'll never, ever give up...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I have everyone's love...
I will never, ever give up!!"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh!" "Way too cool!"
"Cheering for you forever!!" "888888"
"She's so admirable, I'm crying." "You can definitely take on the challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Loves Only You powerfully declared to the community members that she would never give up on the world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And finally,
the staff shared with the expedition members
that a return trip to Japan was in sight...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I can finally return home.
I must start making adjustments for the next one immediately—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Ai-san, have you already
decided on your next race?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will enter the Victoria Mile.
There, I intend to show everyone the run I couldn't deliver this time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The Victoria Mile――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
…………Um. Ai-san, how did you take
this incident yourself?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: No matter how she takes it... well, of course—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—I was sooooooo frustrated!
It felt like I had lost to an infectious disease.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's only for this time.
...From now on, I definitely intend to win.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Win...? But... how do I do that...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll win the Victoria Mile and enchant
everyone watching so much that they completely
forget all about any infectious diseases.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Keep winning after this, keep on winning...
Change history. Forge a new era...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll overwrite this gloomy era of disease with my very presence...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Doesn't that count as winning?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, it's not something easily done.
Perhaps it's a long, painful affliction
that I will have to keep fighting against forever—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Still... at the very least, my spirit will never yield to an infection.
I refuse to give up on a single thing."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this answers your question?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Very much so.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ai-san.
I'll be counting on you after we return to Japan as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And finally, we were able to return to Japan,
and on our way back to the Academy together—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Even amidst such unfairness,
Ai was looking forward with such fierce, powerful eyes.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I feel like I just saw what I was lacking right now.
choice_data_list: As expected, your mental fortitude is extraordinary...
As expected, your mental fortitude is extraordinary...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's precisely why... I want to run alongside Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I feel that by running with her...
I can gain the strength I need
to keep taking on challenges in the future...!
choice_data_list: Then let's go—to the Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Victoria Mile is a Senior-class only 1600m turf GⅠ race held at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It has become the battleground where the heavyweights of the Tiara route gather to determine the pinnacle of the mile—"
choice_data_list: Let's show your strength there once more.
Let us show your strength there once more.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! All the energy I couldn't spend this time, I'll pour it all into the Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...It's okay, I have my community.
Even if infectious diseases keep me from the world
and sever the connections between people—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(The bond between me and my commu-members,
forged through our community... cannot be severed...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I have to move forward...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To take another step toward the world.
The next goal is the Victoria Mile—"
